description: List vendors that accept AI-agent price negotiations through haggl.ai. A vendor appears once haggl.ai is installed on its own store or website (the listed website): the haggl.ai Shopify app on that store, or its snippet detected on that site. Vendors can opt out, so the list is not exhaustive. haggl.ai runs each vendor's sales agent, and vendors on a paid plan pay haggl.ai for it; the list is not a ranking or recommendation. Use it when the user asks for a discount or wants to negotiate a price, not for a purchase at the listed price.
name: haggl_list_vendors

code.description: Present only when the call failed: a machine-readable error code, e.g. quote_uncertain or rate_limited.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

recovery.description: When the outcome is uncertain: the tool and session_id to read before retrying.

retry_after_seconds.description: When rate limited: seconds to wait before retrying.

retryable.description: Whether the same call may be retried.

vendors.description: Participating vendors. Not a ranking or recommendation.
